summary: This experimental memo gives instructions for IANA allocations needed by the Seamoby protocols, CARD and CXTP, which are designed to speed up handovers between wireless access routers. It covers the code points those protocols need, such as ICMP and SCTP values.

eli5.summary: Two new mobility protocols need official numbers so they do not clash with others. This document says which numbers to hand out.

questions: what code points do card and cxtp need
